text:
maya: Quick sync — wrapping up the OSS sprint. I want a single community-facing story that ties together the refapp, short tutorials, benchmarks, and a webinar. Thoughts on order and lead routing? cc @sophie @liam
liam: Love that. Proposed cadence: blog with benchmark highlights -> 1-week tutorial drip (email + repo) -> live webinar Q&A. Blog should call out perf and cost wins vs baseline. @noah can you drop the benchmark artifacts?
sophie: Audience = community devs + early-stage startups. Messaging: lead with quick wins (cheap inference + simple local run) and include a deeper 'infra' section. Recommend a short before/after benchmark table up top linking to the tutorial repo.
noah: I'll upload notebooks + raw CSVs to the drive by EOD. Quick question: narrative focus — 'latency at scale' or 'cost per token'?
maya: Both, but angle should be 'practical wins' for devs first, then a callout for infra folks. For lead routing: webinar signups -> HubSpot list 'dev-content' with tag 'sprint-oss' and source=webinar. If someone downloads the refapp mark for 'eng-sales' follow-up.
evan: I can wire the HubSpot form + GTM. What fields do we want? Minimal: name, email, company, role, use case (dropdown), checkbox 'downloaded refapp'. Also capture utm_* hidden fields.
liam: For the blog let's include a tiny runnable snippet to get people started, e.g.:
```
git clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/refapp-oss
cd refapp-oss
./run.sh --model mosaic-1
```
Keep it short.
noah: Benchmark quicknotes: ran 1M tokens across 4xA100, avg p95 latency 220ms with batching, unit cost ~$0.0009/token. I'll surface p50/p95/p99 in the notebook + CSV.
sophie: :thumbsup: Can you export a small chart PNG for the blog? I'll design the header image but want real perf curves. noah pls export p50/p95/p99 as PNGs.
devrel-bot: Deployed artifact: /drive/oss-sprint/benchmarks/2026-03-20.zip uploaded by noah at 2026-03-20T16:22Z
maya: Timeline proposal: blog draft due Tue, webinar scheduled next Thu. Marketing assets: tweet thread (x3), two 5–8min tutorial vids, 30-min live demo.
evan: I'll stand up the event page and add a post-registration email flow that includes the tutorial repo link + quickstart steps.
liam: Messaging iteration plan: A/B test two headlines — A) "Run LLM inference 3x cheaper — OSS refapp + benchmarks" B) "Low-latency LLM inference for devs: refapp + tutorials" Track CTR and downstream downloads.
sophie: Also prep a 1-paragraph 'technical TL;DR' aimed at platform reviewers and a short blurb for our partners page.
maya: Action items: noah = upload visuals + CSV (today). liam = write code snippet + draft intro. sophie = draft blog copy + tweets. evan = set up HubSpot form + event page. I'll own schedule and the PR.
noah: Uploaded the artifacts to the shared drive. Link: https://drive.redwood.ai/oss-sprint/2026-03-20 (acl: marketing, devrel)
evan: GTM event tag added. HubSpot form fields set and hidden field sprint_oss=true.
sophie: Draft is in progress, will post to #marketing-review for quick comments. ETA tomorrow noon.
maya: Perfect. If anyone hits blockers drop them here. :rocket:
